attributes.board_name: Junta Examinadora de Terapia Ocupacional de Puerto Rico (Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education; at most 21 hours may come from modules, journals or internet courses (Res. 2025-44).
rules.audit_note: Documents are presented in print at renewal; renewal also needs ASUME certification and criminal record certificates (PR and place of residence, under 30 days old). Renew about 90 days before expiry.

topics.who: Ethics course, in addition to the 30 hours (Res. 2005/12/22)
Course "Equidad y Respeto": bioethics and discrimination in all legally recognized forms (from 2024, Orden Adm. 2024-583; Res. 2024-43); within the 30 hours

rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 137 de 26 de junio de 1968, as amended (20 L.P.R.A. §1031 et seq.); recertification under 24 L.P.R.A. §3001 et seq.
rules.notes: Board document 'Requisitos de Renovación de licencia de Terapia Ocupacional (62)' (2025-03-11): 30 hours of CE + 3 additional hours of ethics = 33 hours per recertification period. Recertification period taken as 3 years (Puerto Rico health-professional recertification); the board document itself does not state the period.
rules.rule_quote: Requisitos de Renovación de licencia de Terapia Ocupacional (62) ➢ 30 horas Educación Continua + 3 horas adicional por el curso de (ÉTICA).

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education; at most 15 hours may come from modules, journals or internet courses (Res. 2025-44).
rules.audit_note: Documents presented in print at renewal with ASUME certification and criminal record certificates (under 30 days). Renew about 90 days before expiry.

topics.who: Ethics course, in addition to the 21 hours (Res. 2005/12/22)
Course "Equidad y Respeto" (from 2024, Orden Adm. 2024-583); within the 21 hours

rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 137 de 26 de junio de 1968, as amended; Ley 220-2012 (autism)
rules.notes: Board document 'Requisitos de Renovación de licencia de Asistente de Terapia Ocupacional (63)' (2025-03-11): 21 hours of CE + 3 additional hours of ethics = 24. Also: 15 hours for any professional who evaluates, diagnoses or treats people with autism spectrum disorder (Ley 220-2012) — no matching topic code. Recertification period taken as 3 years; the document does not state it.
rules.rule_quote: Requisitos de Renovación de licencia de Asistente de Terapia Ocupacional (63) ➢ 21 horas Educación Continua + 3 horas adicional por el curso (ÉTICA).
